descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-22 Task Closure & Extraction · S16 Look-alike tasks: a BMP result does not close the CBC task, a PT visit does not close the OT task, and a new short-acronym order is not merged away as a duplicate

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U2 Save & Extract closes the open tasks whose results are dictated in ordinary phrasing ('BMP came back, creatinine 1.1'; 'PT saw her, walking with a walker'). … (UAT TC-22; TFA-92592 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U3 No duplicates: closing a task adds no new task for the same item, and Save & Extract never adds a task that is already on the list, open or closed (UAT TC-22; TFA-92592 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U4 The task whose result is not dictated ('recheck weight in two weeks') stays open (UAT TC-22; TFA-92592 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U8 All of the above in Nursing Home as well as Hospital, passing in both (UAT TC-22 step 4; UAT 3.3; TFA-92592 AC 14) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U10 Never invent, never drop: a task made from the dictation contains nothing that was not dictated (no added dose, route, frequency or urgency, no supplied decision) and keeps what was dictated, includi … (UAT 3.4; TFA-94229 R8; TFA-94229 R9) — gate: blocked: TFA-94229 in progress

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given W1: open 'Follow up BMP', 'Follow up CBC', 'PT eval', 'OT eval'. W2: open 'Follow up BMP' only

When W1: Save & Extract with 'BMP came back, creatinine 1.1. PT saw her, walking with a walker.' W2: 'BMP came back, creatinine 1.1. Follow up a CBC tomorrow morning.' Both contexts, through the client's merge

Then W1: BMP and PT eval close; CBC and OT eval stay open; nothing added. W2: BMP closes and a CBC task is added and kept

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): U2 closes the matching task only; U4 the others stay open. W2: U10 'never drop' / U3 (dedup must not misfire): mergeTasksDedup ignores words of 3 letters or fewer, so 'Follow up CBC' reduces to the same signature as 'Follow up BMP' ('follow') and is dropped; predicted Fail on main when the model words it that way. …

Where it ran: dev; test method AICHECK · AI output check; lane planned in the matrix: AI check (automated)

S16 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-22.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Test method: AICHECK · AI output check; secondary: CODEREVIEW · Code review — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
